original_ai_output.title_zh: 瓦乌军事法庭判处一名士兵10年监禁，因其杀害联合国工作人员
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹瓦乌一军事法庭判处一名南苏丹人民国防军（SSPDF）士兵10年监禁，罪名是绑架并杀害一名联合国工作人员。联合国南苏丹特派团（UNMISS）表示，该判决仍可上诉。法庭还下令将该士兵降级并开除军籍，并向受害者家属赔偿51头牛。

location.raw_text: Wau, Western Bahr el Ghazal state

key_facts.fact: 瓦乌军事法庭判处一名SSPDF士兵10年监禁，因其绑架并杀害一名联合国工作人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A military court in Wau has sentenced a South Sudan People’s Defence Forces (SSPDF) soldier to 10 years in prison for the abduction and murder of a United Nations staff member

key_facts.fact: 受害者Bol Rhoch Mayol Kuot是UNMISS的语言助理，于2025年12月15日在西加扎勒河州Hai Masna执行公务时被绑架并杀害
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Bol Rhoch Mayol Kuot, a South Sudanese national who worked as a language assistant for the United Nations Mission in South Sudan (UNMISS), was abducted and killed on Dec. 15, 2025, while on official duty in Hai Masna, Western Bahr el Ghazal state.

key_facts.fact: 法庭还下令将该士兵降级并开除军籍，并向受害者家属赔偿51头牛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The General Court Martial also ordered the soldier’s demotion and dismissal from the army and awarded the victim’s family compensation of 51 head of cattle.
The ruling is subject to appeal, UNMISS said.

key_facts.fact: 自2011年7月9日UNMISS成立以来，已有19名维和人员被杀、32人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Since UNMISS was established on July 9, 2011, 19 peacekeepers have been killed and 32 injured in what the mission described as malicious acts.

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
判决仍可上诉，最终结果尚未确定
